K01.drivers: very wide blocky trunk with no waist, oversized forearms and hands, massive thick legs with knobby joint bulges, very large broad feet, trunk wider than shoulder-to-hand span leaves armpit holes in silhouette
axial_cues: barrel trunk with no waist taper
short trunk relative to thick limbs

structure.axial_section_shape: block-like trunk, chest and pelvis nearly same width, deep in profile
structure.joint_integration: joints swell into lumpy masses rather than tapering; knees and ankles bulge
structure.segment_relations: forearms, hands and feet oversized relative to trunk; legs thick and comparatively short
structure.load_path: weight spread through a wide pelvis into columnar legs onto broad, heavy feet

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk and muscle are prominent but the oversized hands/feet and joint shapes go beyond a heavy human

K02.drivers: slim ordinary proportions, normal waist taper, normal arm length to mid-thigh

structure.axial_section_shape: slim oval trunk, chest slightly wider than pelvis
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis and straight legs to normal feet

K03.drivers: very long thin arms reaching well below the crotch, long fingers, narrow pelvis and slim legs, profile shows forward-bulging upper chest and slight stoop
axial_cues: slight forward stoop of upper trunk

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow trunk with top-heavy deep upper chest and slender pelvis
structure.joint_integration: thin limbs with little joint mass; shoulders sloped and narrow
structure.segment_relations: arms and hands disproportionately long; legs long and thin
structure.load_path: weight carried slightly forward over thin straight legs to long narrow feet

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness contributes but arm length and chest shape are the main oddity

K04.drivers: same build as K03: very long arms and fingers, slender narrow trunk, profile with projecting upper chest/back, thin legs

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow trunk, top-heavy profile, slim pelvis
structure.joint_integration: minimal joint mass, sloped narrow shoulders
structure.segment_relations: long arms and hands relative to trunk; long thin legs
structure.load_path: slightly forward-carried trunk over straight slender legs

K05.drivers: same massive build as K01: blocky waistless trunk, very large forearms and hands, lumpy thick legs, huge feet, visible pectoral/abdominal ridges

structure.axial_section_shape: block trunk, no waist, deep in profile
structure.segment_relations: hands and feet oversized; thick comparatively short legs
structure.load_path: wide pelvis into columnar legs onto broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: near-duplicate of K01, slightly more defined musculature

K06.drivers: ordinary proportions, slight hip width, normal arm length

K07.drivers: ordinary average build, slightly broader shoulders

K08.drivers: slightly broader, sturdier average build, normal proportions

structure.axial_section_shape: broad oval trunk with mild waist

K09.drivers: ordinary build, wider hips and buttock projection in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: trunk with pelvis near chest width

K11.drivers: ordinary build with a soft belly protrusion in profile, visible navel

K12.drivers: ordinary skeleton with a pronounced belly in profile, thick waist

structure.load_path: vertical, belly mass forward of pelvis

non_structural_factors.notes: overweight but within ordinary range; borderline B

groups.label: massive block-trunk, oversized hands/feet, lumpy joints

distinguishing_features: K01/K05 are massive with waistless block trunks, huge forearms, hands and feet, and knobby joints; K03/K04 are slender and narrow with very long arms and fingers and a projecting upper chest in profile. They are opposites in bulk and proportion and cannot be confused.
